answer: The spiral register is checked at draw time, shale lists the eligible set, and gale seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 53 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 53 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Each copy needs 9 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
